primary_comparison: proposed Bayesian vs CQR; no confirmatory test in pilot
practical_decision_rule: effect sizes only; no fixed practical-superiority/equivalence threshold

sampling.sampler: nutpie if validated; explicit recorded fallback

failure_criteria.synthetic_interpretation: Four fixed regimes are recovery diagnostics, not repeated-sampling calibration certification. Gross systematic parameter bias or prior dominance requires revision; no post-hoc acceptance threshold tuned to fits.

calibration_residual_access_policy: Only after all CQR configurations and Bayesian training candidate policy frozen; pilot outcomes remain exploratory.
stopping: Preserve each failure. If sampling/identifiability fail, recommend REVISE AGAIN rather than claim readiness.
